content:
Tool execution error!

Possible root causes: Confluence rejected the request because the account behind the ELITEA credential is not allowed to access Confluence at all. This is not a label problem—the tool calls Confluence’s “get pages by label” API, and Confluence returned an authorization error before any page lookup could happen. The FAQ also points to permission/authentication issues, such as an invalid token, wrong hosting option, or the account lacking access to the target Confluence site/space.

Suggested fixes:  
- Verify the ELITEA Confluence credential is correct and uses a valid API token or password.  
- Confirm the account associated with that credential can log in to Confluence in a browser.  
- Check that the account has access to the Confluence instance and the target space `AT`.  
- Make sure the toolkit is configured for the right hosting type (Cloud vs Server).  
- If this is EPAM Confluence, log in via browser first or use a dedicated service account with a permanent license.

*IMPORTANT*: if fixing logic is clear - you can re-try tool execution according to fix.
If you continue experiencing issues, please [contact support](https://elitea.ai/docs/support/contact-support/)
